privacy.metaDescription: Kikiboard privacy policy and cookie use.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Body: The controller of data collected through kikiboard.xyz is the team behind Kikiboard. For any privacy question you can contact us at contact@kikiboard.xyz.
privacy.s2AccountBody: name, email address and authentication provider (email/password or Google OAuth), managed through Clerk.
privacy.s2ContentBody: boards, lists, tickets, subtasks, comments and attachments you create on the platform.
privacy.s2UsageBody: activity logs inside boards (actions taken, dates).
privacy.s3P3: Enable collaboration between members of a board.
privacy.s3P4: Send notifications related to user activity.
privacy.s4Intro: Kikiboard uses strictly necessary cookies for the application to work:
privacy.s4SessionBody: managed by Clerk to keep your session active securely.
privacy.s4PrefsBody: stored in localStorage (for example, acceptance of this policy). They are not sent to any server.
privacy.s4NoTrack: We do not use tracking, advertising or third-party analytics cookies.
privacy.s5Vercel: Vercel — deployment infrastructure and file storage.
privacy.s5Footer: Each of these services has its own privacy policy and security measures.
privacy.s6Body: Data is kept while the account is active. When you delete your account, all your data is permanently and irreversibly removed from our database.
privacy.s7Body: You have the right to access, rectify and delete your data. You can exercise these rights from your account settings or by contacting us at contacto@kikiboard.xyz.
privacy.s8Body: We may update this policy occasionally. For relevant changes we will notify you through the platform or by email.

board-lists.title: Your lists
board-lists.body: Each column is a stage of the work. Drag a ticket from one to the next and it moves; drop it on a list named done and it closes on its own.

view-toggle.body: The same board, two ways of reading it. The list view is more comfortable when there are many tickets, and you can move them from there too.

board-filters.title: Filters
board-filters.body: Narrow it down by label, person, priority, epic or quarter. They combine, so you can go from the whole board to one person's week.

board-ai.title: Brain Dump
board-ai.body: Write or dictate everything on your mind and the AI turns it into separate tickets. You need your own key, which you set in Settings.

howItWorks.metaDescription: From an empty board to a team that ships: the five steps of working in Kiki, explained end to end.
howItWorks.title: From an empty board to a team that ships
howItWorks.subtitle: No manual and no setup call. This is the <underline>whole flow</underline>, in the order it actually happens.

board.title: Create your board
board.body: A board is one project. Give it a name, pick a color, and if you already know your stages, name them right there while you create it.
board.b1: Starter lists on creation, or add them later
board.b2: Story points and other useful fields, already set up
board.b3: As many boards as projects you run

structure.title: Shape the work into lists and tickets
structure.body: Every column is a stage. Every card is a ticket. Move a card to the right and the work advances; drop it on a done column and it closes itself.
structure.b1: Drag and drop, or move from a menu in the list view
structure.b2: Labels, priority, dates, subtasks and attachments per ticket
structure.b3: Epics and quarters when a single board is not enough

team.title: Invite the team and share the load
team.body: Invite by email and give each person a role. Then hand out the work: one owner per ticket, an optional reviewer, and whoever else needs to be there.
team.b1: Owner, admin and member, enforced by the API
team.b2: Assignee, QA reviewer and collaborators per ticket
team.b3: Everyone involved gets notified, nobody has to chase

ai.title: Let the AI do the boring part
ai.body: The hardest part of a new project is turning what is in your head into separate tickets. Write it or say it out loud, and get the board filled for you.
ai.b1: Brain Dump: a paragraph becomes a list of tickets
ai.b2: Dictate by voice if typing gets in the way
ai.b3: Your own key, so nothing is charged to you by surprise

measure.title: Measure, close and clear
measure.body: The dashboard tells you what is overdue, what closed this week and how the load is spread. Finished work gets archived, not deleted.
measure.b2: Progress per board and per epic
measure.b3: Archive keeps history without cluttering the board

visuals.brainDumpText: We need to redo the landing, fix login on mobile and prepare the launch newsletter before Friday.

price.a: Nothing. Kiki is free to use, and the AI features run on your own provider key, so whatever you spend there you pay to them directly, not to us.

data.a: Only the people you invite to a board. Every endpoint checks membership before answering, and a ticket is only visible outside the board if you generate a share link yourself.

team.q: How many people can join a board?
team.a: There is no limit. You invite by email, and each person gets a role: admin if they should manage the board, member if they should just work on tickets.

ai.q: Do I need an AI key?
ai.a: Only for the AI features. Everything else works without it. You can bring a key from OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi or any compatible endpoint, and it is stored encrypted.

languages.a: English, Spanish and Tagalog. You switch from the globe in the top bar and the choice sticks, including the dates and the activity log.

export.q: Can I connect it to my own tools?
export.a: Yes. Board activity can go to Slack or Discord through a webhook, due dates can sync to Google Calendar, and there is an MCP server so an AI assistant can work on your boards directly.

howItWorks.ctaTitle: Your first board takes about a minute
howItWorks.ctaBody: No credit card, no setup call, no demo to sit through.

createBoard.title: Start with a board
createBoard.body: Press here, give it a name and pick a color. A board is one project — everything else lives inside it.

addList.title: Add your first list
addList.body: Each list is a stage of the work: To do, In progress, Done. Name a list “Done” and dropping a ticket there closes it on its own.

createTicket.title: Create a ticket
createTicket.body: A title is enough to start. Dates, labels, people and subtasks come later, by opening the card.

inviteTeammate.title: Bring your team in
inviteTeammate.body: Open Members and invite by email. Give each person a role: admin to manage the board, member to work on tickets.

connectAi.title: Paste your AI key
connectAi.body: With a key from your own provider you unlock Brain Dump, voice dictation and one-click rewriting. It is stored encrypted.
